clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 2, every precompile path that runs other code: crates/precompiles/src/storage/evm.rs:683-746 (EvmPrecompileStorageProvider::call) is a CALL frame on the shared journal and transient map, with no transaction environment and no clear_transaction_state.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched crates/precompiles/src/storage/evm.rs at tempo 0fe724b from raw.githubusercontent.com and read lines 683-746. The function builds a MessageExt of kind Call or StaticCall at frame.depth + 1 with the precompile as caller, refuses the call when open_checkpoints is nonzero or nested_calls reaches MAX_NESTED_CALLS, and runs self.evm.execute_call. It does not build a TxEnv and does not touch transient storage. A callee therefore sees the PoolManager's IS_UNLOCKED_SLOT, NONZERO_DELTA_COUNT_SLOT, deltas and synced currency as they stand, as a contract CALL would, and the check at src/PoolManager.sol:112 still runs on the same values.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 4, transient storage across the phases of one 0x76 transaction: cleared once at commit or discard of the whole transaction; a batch failure rolls back every TSTORE through the journal; a sync carried between calls of one batch credits only the same account.
clearedSpotChecks.note: evm2 7c9f3b6d crates/evm2/src/evm/state/mod.rs, fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com: clear_transaction_state at :564-580 clears transient_storage together with the journal; tstore at :846-870 pushes a TransientStorageChange journal entry for every changed value, so rollback undoes it; take_transient_storage at :882-887 removes only the slots of the address it is given. Tempo 0fe724b crates/evm/src/handler.rs, fetched the same way, takes one checkpoint at :1296 before the calls and rolls back to it at :1302 and :1346, and contains no transient clear. In src/, unlock reverts unless NonzeroDeltaCount is zero and relocks before returning (src/PoolManager.sol:104-114), so no later call inherits an unlocked state. sync writes synced currency and reserves (src/PoolManager.sol:279-288) and _settle credits balanceOf minus synced reserves to the caller or its named recipient and resets the currency (src/PoolManager.sol:349-364). All calls of a 0x76 batch share one sender and no other transaction can run between them, so a carried sync credits only tokens the batch itself sent. This matches one contract doing sync and settle in one Ethereum transaction.
